In high school I had a bad ingrown toenail on my right big toe, hurt like a bitch and would puss all the time, causing my socks to stick to the infected spot, basically all my socks ended up with a brown spot at the big toe. After about 3 weeks I could barely walk and it got to the point when I knew I was going to have to dig it out myself. I stole an exacto knife from art class and when I got home (keep in mind that by this point it was sensitive as fuck) I just held my breath and dug that bastard out, I swear I thought I was going to pass out it hurt so fucking bad. But the next few days were like heaven once it started healing.

While this is insane without anesthetic or sterile technique, that's pretty close to how I do a wedge resection of an ingrown nail.

Honestly, now that I think about it... having a (sterile) implement that is pretty much a flat head screwdriver might be helpful for elevating the nail...
